maturity_vocabulary.M1_SINGLE_OFFICIAL_LISTING: Named as a quebrada by one archived official source only (here: a critical-point listing).
maturity_vocabulary.M2_MULTI_SOURCE_IDENTITY: Named by two or more archived official sources; their referring to the same channel is NOT asserted.
maturity_vocabulary.M3_PERIOD_EVENT_LEAD: M2 plus a per-unit damage statement in an archived official source, period-level only (no day): EVENT_LEAD_UNVERIFIED in the audit.

flag_vocabulary.HOMONYM_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED: The same label names other features (other districts, departments, settlements or sectors).
flag_vocabulary.ALIAS_ADJUDICATION_PENDING: A documentary relation with another label exists and is not adjudicated.
flag_vocabulary.GEOMETRY_UNKNOWN: No reproducible channel or catchment geometry.
flag_vocabulary.OUTLET_UNKNOWN: No reproducible outlet or confluence point.
flag_vocabulary.NOT_MAP_ELIGIBLE: Never published to the map by this registry.

registration_vocabulary.NEW_ROW_IN_MASTER_INVENTORY: A new candidate row was added to the national audit (r3).

requested_names.note: Main names a Quebrada Fernández system (Bocapán evidence) and quarantines its same-name use for the Máncora child; Anexo II also lists Qda. Fernández in Piura (II-68). Not merged.

Several Tumbes features carry the label: Anexo II row 3 uses 'Quebrada Seca' as a SECTOR of a Río Zarumilla point (Matapalo); INGEMMET names a 'Quebrada Seca - Pajaritos' road section; Ley 32573 names a quebrada Seca whose upper reach is called Hualtacal. None is attached to the row.
Main holds the Casitas-Bocapán drainage only as ANA hydrographic-unit context; the audit row 'Panales-Casitas' (Andina 2024) is kept separate.
Sector of the same name; ANA 2016 map 3743 prints a centro poblado 'CARRETAS'.
Own row. Possible equivalence with the existing row 'Casa Blanqueada - I.E. 7 de Junio' (ANA 2016, same district; Anexo II gives sector Casa Blanqueada) is UNRESOLVED.
Already registered in PR #364 (unit tumbes_san_jacinto_quebrada_hualaca); the audit row indexes it. Relation to Higuerón UNRESOLVED.
Named in PR #364 as context. Contexts: San Jacinto / Rica Playa (Anexo II), Contralmirante Villar–Tumbes divide and upper reach of a quebrada Seca (Ley 32573), ANA 2016 Cancas and Canoas maps.
Sector of the same name. INGEMMET 2017 road damage from flows of the quebrada Plateros is period-level only.
INGEMMET 2017 names a 'Quebrada Santa María' (district not printed in the row) and 'Santa María de Dios' in distrito Tumbes: not attached. Lima homonym in the audit.
COEN RC 3755 names settlements/sectors 'Nueva Esperanza' in Corrales and in Aguas Verdes (not quebradas). Lambayeque homonym in the audit.
Kept apart from 'Barrio Santa Rosa-Uña de Gato' (Papayal) and from the INGEMMET quebrada Santa Rosa in distrito Tumbes. Ica homonym in the audit.

Own row. Possible equivalence with the existing row 'Malval' (ANA 2016, same district Corrales) is UNRESOLVED. INGEMMET C-36 (flows from the slopes of sector Malval) and COEN (sector Malvales) are not attached as quebrada evidence.
